One of my favorites is Joyless Street. One of the most incredibly depressive films from that era
 It blew me away when I saw it, so I checked Kracauer and he barely mentioned it. I assume it must have fallen into obscurity at some point. I think it's an essential film that might get lost in the shuffle because so many people rely on Kracauer as the standard text.
Early appearance of Greta Garbo no less.
Cool! Yes, I’ve consulted ChatGPT quite frequently. I hope you get just as much enjoyment out of the genre as I do!
Ah yes! From G.W. Pabst, the same guy who directed Secrets of a Soul.
